title: SCP: Site-86 [ALPHA]
description: An asymmetrical team PvP experience inspired by the SCP Genre
body:
An asymmetrical team PvP experience inspired by the SCP Genre.

All parties involved have trouble coming their way - only those who can fight it through will find peace in the end.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Bl3n5Vkw4GE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

# Featuring

- Ability to play as Class-D, Mobile Task Force, Facility Guard, Chaos Insurgency, SCP-173 and SCP-049(-1)
- Many interactable SCPs within the world of Site-86
- Original Soundtrack
- Progression, featuring 10 unlockable perks total with unique gadgets and weapons
